Ref: Marine Reptile(Carretta caretta) Sampling

Hello,

I am preparing for a population survey of nesting Sea Turtles(Caretta
caretta) in the mediterranean this summer. I plan to use transsect analysis
and Distance V.3.5. The nesting population on the specific bay is
small(n<400 per annum) and the potential beach extends for some 30KM.
Therefore I would like to ask for reference for any kind of experience of
tracking nesting sea turtle populations using Distance V.3.5. Does anyone
know basic configs or specific reference for such a model or even has
experience for such a kind of modeling with Distance V.3.5.? Thanks for your
help.

Sincerely,
